milestone: Rotate functionality for the Image content section
slice: Direct product request: 'in the builder for images i need rotate functionality.' The sibling Graphics/Shape content section already had a working graphicRotation field and Rotation slider (0-359deg) applied uniformly by EngineV2Runtime.paintLayer, tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/builder.js's convergeSceneLayer (compiled decoration.rotation), and renderer/slideRenderer.js's _layerDrawDecorationImage -- confirmed all three were ALREADY fully generic to a decoration layer's own .rotation field regardless of image-vs-shape source, so the whole gap was purely authoring-side. experienceSchema.js's defaultUniversalContent() gained imageRotation:0 alongside the existing imageFit/imageOpacity fields. A real, confirmed bug in projectModel.js's _syncUniversalContent was the actual root cause blocking even a correctly-added control: the shapeFields fallback object hardcoded rotation:0 for the image slot on every sync (shapeKind computation is gated on spec.slot==='graphic' only) -- fixed by computing rotation as its own variable (props.imageRotation||0 for the image slot, unchanged graphicRotation logic for shapes) and spreading it onto both the update-existing-layer and create-new-layer branches, so an uploaded Image's Rotation now persists durably across repeated syncs instead of being silently reset to 0 on every unrelated property edit. worldBuilderApp.js gained a Rotation field group (_buildFieldGroup('Rotation', _range(0,359,...))) in the Image content section's Inspector, right after its existing Transform (Move/Resize) fields, plus the matching rotation:props.imageRotation||0 in the isolated Experience Studio's own live-preview paintLayer call so Working View/Runtime Preview show the rotation immediately while authoring. Verified via a 19-assertion Playwright suite across 4 parts: the real UI (create an Image Experience via the real '+ Add Experience' sequence, click the real Image Content Kind button, drag the real Rotation slider) confirms props.imageRotation persists AND the mirrored Scene Layer's own .rotation field reflects it -- not hardcoded to 0 -- with a subsequent, unrelated Opacity edit confirmed NOT to stomp rotation back to 0 on the same sync pass; EngineV2Runtime.paintLayer confirmed to genuinely call ctx.rotate() with the correct radian angle for a real image layer, and to make zero ctx.rotate() calls for rotation:0 (byte-identical no-op for every existing theme); a real compile-time test through the actual Experience mirror (addExperience->graduateToPersonal->attachExperience->updateExperienceProperty) confirms builder.js's convergeSceneLayer carries the real mirrored Layer's rotation:275 through to the compiled Layer Pack entry's decoration.rotation unchanged, with the real image bytes still correctly embedded (Draft Asset Architecture unaffected); and root Studio's renderer/slideRenderer.js is confirmed to genuinely call ctx.rotate() with a compiled decoration.rotation (66deg) for an image-kind World-owned Decoration, closing the loop on Creator Governing Rule #5 (Publish Fidelity). Full regression across both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2, unaffected -- this fix touches zero v1 files) and the existing Collection Phase 1-6/scene-dropdown-repro Playwright suites passes unchanged. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/experienceSchema.js, tools/world-builder-v2/js/projectModel.js, and tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js.
